decisions.reason: The source adds a physical placement policy owned by the connector-alignment Requirement; it does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, roles, or power chain.
The source context concerns the vertically mounted main and sensor boards, not the power-board battery and interboard connector arrangement.
Minimizing bottom-side connectors does not itself change the main-board dimensions or establish a resolution to the reported fit failure.
The connector-access policy does not change the number, identity, or separation of the project boards.
The source applies to main- and sensor-board connector accessibility and does not modify the power board's orientation, dimensions, USB-C placement, or mounting holes.
Connector placement on the board edges has no entailed effect on the selected four-layer stack.
The source does not alter the sensor-board connector inventory, connector count, types, or signal assignments; its physical edge-placement constraint is already represented by the source Requirement.
The board-edge connector policy does not change the monitored rails, monitor device, channel count, or measurement coverage.
The source does not identify or change the panel-control connector inventory, GPIO assignments, or external-control policy; duplicating the board-level placement rule here is unnecessary.
The connector-placement policy does not affect the standalone USB supply source, regulator capacity, powered rail, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not modify I2C cable length, pull-ups, series resistors, topology, or bus speed.
The source does not change the SPS30 connector type, cable compatibility, supply voltage, or signal pin assignments; physical board-edge placement remains covered by the source Requirement.
